findings.headline: Joint US-Japan yen intervention fading — yen erases half gains within 2 weeks
findings.summary: The unprecedented joint US-Japan FX intervention (first in 15 years) has already lost half its effect. Yen weakened past 158/dollar on Aug 10 after weaker US jobs data. Authorities 'may step in again' — verbal warnings intensifying. CNBC calls it 'weaponized yen' with geopolitical tinge. Bessent involved in Treasury operations.

findings.headline: Jim Rickards: 'Yentervention' is biggest story in the world — financial equivalent of nuclear war
findings.summary: Rickards warns the US is using Fed dollars to prop up yen specifically to prevent carry trade unwinding and market collapse. Calls the intervention 'the biggest story in the world.' DollarCollapse warns yen headed to 200 then 300 per 'milkshake theory' but cautions against shorting a currency Washington has vowed to defend.

findings.headline: Australia banking system exposed to yen funding — RBA holds at 4.35%
findings.summary: Australian banking system identified as one of most exposed to yen funding. RBA held cash rate at 4.35% effective Aug 12. Property corrections in Sydney/Melbourne creating underwater mortgages. Preppgroup warns of crisis of confidence requiring central bank intervention to prevent bank runs.

findings.headline: Jamie Dimon warns massive hidden debt could trigger sudden crashes
findings.summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warns that massive amounts of hidden debt buried deep inside global financial markets — particularly in SVPS securitization and off-book debt — could trigger sudden crashes. Daily Caller reports this as a direct warning about Trump economy obfuscation.

findings.headline: Telegraph: 'Ingredients coming together for a US financial crisis'
findings.summary: The Telegraph reports that IMF forecasts US general government deficit of 7.4% GDP or higher every year from 2026 to 2031. Article lays out case that fiscal and financial crisis ingredients are converging. This is a mainstream UK broadsheet explicitly using 'crisis' framing.

findings.headline: Treasury penalizes AML failures — Russian/Iranian elites using shell companies
findings.summary: FDD reports Treasury cracking down on anti-money laundering failures after weak enforcement. Russian and Iranian elites leveraging shell companies to stash money in bank accounts and luxury properties. Banks' failures to report suspicious activity enabling adversaries.

findings.headline: Fed Chair Warsh abandons forward guidance, adopts 'cryptic messaging' — return to Greenspan obfuscation
findings.summary: Under Chair Kevin Warsh, the Fed has abandoned forward guidance on future rates, shortened FOMC statements, and focused only on current economy. The Economist calls it 'restoring mystery' to Fed communications. Bloomberg warns this reverses 30 years of transparency. Markets losing ability to price future policy path.

findings.headline: ECB unwinding QE programmes — rates unchanged since June 2026 after 8 cuts
findings.summary: ECB cut rates 8 times from June 2024 to June 2025, then held unchanged until June 2026. Now unwinding both main QE programmes including pandemic-related QE. UK House of Commons Library documents the shift. This tightening posture while economy weakens is a classic policy error precursor.

findings.headline: OMFIF proposes new central banking canon — fiscal anti-inflation rules with defined triggers
findings.summary: OMFIF calls for rules-based fiscal anti-inflation policy with pre-legislated stabilisers, defined triggers, caps and sunset clauses. Proposes central banks take formal surveillance role over systemically significant prices. This represents elite consensus building for major framework shift.

findings.headline: Four-crisis convergence: Hormuz, Ukraine, North Korea, China — 'most dangerous geopolitical moment'
findings.summary: Foreign Affairs Forum reports convergence of four previously distinct crises: Strait of Hormuz closure, Russia's escalating missile campaign against Ukraine, North Korea's military integration into European war, and US-China multi-domain confrontation. Calls this the world's most dangerous geopolitical moment. RealClearDefense warns of 'Guns of August 2026.'

findings.headline: Iran formalizing control over Strait of Hormuz — CISA elevated advisory posture
findings.summary: Congressional Research Service reports Iran views formalizing control over entire Strait as critical to national interests. Iranian attacks on shipping and US retaliatory strikes have severely disrupted traffic for 5 months. CISA maintains elevated advisory posture for energy, financial, and defense networks as of August 2026.

findings.headline: Russia escalating missile campaign on Kyiv — North Korean military integration deepens
findings.summary: ISW reports Russian ballistic strikes on Kyiv killed 9, wounded 33 including 4 children. Struck ambulances, residential buildings, school, Lithuanian Embassy. North Korea deepening military integration into European war. Ceasefire violations by Israel in southern Lebanon simultaneously.

findings.headline: Strait of Hormuz shipping disrupted for 5 months — oil/gas traffic largely blocked
findings.summary: Congressional Research Service confirms periodic Iranian attacks against shipping and US retaliatory strikes have severely disrupted Hormuz traffic for most of past 5 months as of early August 2026. Houthis also attacking Saudi oil tankers. Trump says Hormuz reopening 'soon' but deal remains elusive.

findings.headline: Asian port congestion hits 2.4M TEU — carriers forced back to Red Sea
findings.summary: Container ship capacity delayed in Asia following tropical storms has reached 2.4 million TEU. Carriers reverting services to Red Sea to compensate. Long delays expected along China's eastern seaboard from Shanghai to Ningbo to Guangdong ports. Terminal operations halted Aug 7-8. Weeks to clear backlog.

findings.headline: US import volumes declining after August — tariff-driven rush ending
findings.summary: NRF Global Port Tracker forecasts August at 2.22M TEU (down 4.2% YoY), with declining volumes through end of 2026. Peak shipping season cut short amid tariff shifts and geopolitical disruption. C.H. Robinson reports Mexico exports up double digits but border scrutiny straining trucking capacity. Panama, Caribbean, Asian hubs all disrupted.

findings.headline: EU AI Act final tranche in force — credit scoring, insurance, banking now regulated
findings.summary: On Aug 2 2026, final EU AI Act obligations came into force, folding credit scoring, insurance underwriting, and widening list of high-risk banking use cases into single European rulebook. This is a major regulatory shift for financial services with direct impact on credit availability and underwriting processes.

findings.headline: US Treasury clearing trade submission requirement — FCCC rule change deadline Aug 23
findings.summary: Federal Register publishes notice of longer period for Commission Action on FCCC rule change to adopt US Treasury clearing trade submission requirement. 45th day after publication is Aug 23, 2026. This reshapes Treasury market plumbing.

findings.headline: CFTC extends comment period on 24/7 energy derivatives trading — stays crude oil contract approval
findings.summary: CFTC extended comment period to Aug 26 on proposal permitting 24/7 trading in energy derivatives, and stayed approval of proposed 24/7 crude oil contract. CFTC also settled manipulation charges against former Congressman for event contract tied to State of the Union attendance.

findings.headline: MiFID II order execution standards + Market Abuse Regulation updates published in EU OJ
findings.summary: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/825 supplementing MiFID II with RTS on order execution policies published in Official Journal. Multiple Market Abuse Regulation delegated regulations also published. FCA published PS26/16 on UK equity IPO information flows. All enter force Aug 19, 2026.
findings.source: National Law Review, Mondaq, Regulation Tomorrow

findings.headline: Northern Ireland race riots — Belfast burning, far-right agitators amplifying
findings.summary: Guardian reports Northern Ireland race riots unfolded with far-right agitators (Musk, Tommy Robinson) amplifying calls to protest. Most complete picture yet of how single incident precipitated crisis. Wikipedia documents ongoing unrest with second night of rioters attacking police.

findings.headline: Iran protests ongoing — military-grade jammers used against civilians
findings.summary: 2025-2026 Iranian protests continue with authorities activating military-grade jammers to disrupt civilian Starlink. Connectivity heavily restricted. Measures widely seen as suppressing dissent and controlling narrative around unrest.

findings.headline: Ceuta migrant crisis — Spain-Morocco border tensions, Sánchez facing protests
findings.summary: 2026 Ceuta migrant crisis with Pedro Sánchez arriving in Ceuta amid insults and strong protests over migration crisis. Wikipedia documents this as an active border incident between Morocco and Spain.

findings.headline: Kashmir political crisis — biggest protests in years ahead of regional elections
findings.summary: Pakistan-administered Kashmir facing biggest political crisis in years with deadly protests ahead of final round of regional elections. AJK PM offers fresh talks amid clashes. Pakistan minister calls protesters 'enemies like India.'

findings.headline: HY credit spreads at 271bps — bid-ask widening signals stress building
findings.summary: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS at 271bps as of Aug 6. ConvexTrade warns bid-ask spreads can widen from 0.5 to 3-5 points during stress, adding 50-100+ bps to true trading cost. Illiquidity amplifying spread moves. FRED data shows series restricted to 3 years from April 2026.

findings.headline: US jobs report: Nonfarm Payrolls FALL by 12,000 — labor market weaker than believed
findings.summary: July jobs report (released Aug 7) shows employers shed 23,000 jobs (NYT) / Nonfarm Payrolls fell 12,000 (ABN AMRO). Previous months revised down sharply. Labor force participation falls to 61.4% as 264,000 Americans leave. Seeking Alpha notes YoY nonfarm employment at or below level seen at start of 12 of last 13 recessions. Sahm Rule being closely watched.
findings.source: NYT, ABN AMRO, BLS, Seeking Alpha, FRED

findings.headline: Treasuries rally, bond volatility at multi-month highs — bear steepening reversed
findings.summary: Nuveen reports Treasuries rallied broadly led by front end, reversing prior bear-steepening and pushing bond volatility to multi-month highs. BlackRock sees structurally higher cost of capital, underweight HY credit strategically. Inflation uncertainty driving term premium demand.

findings.headline: Carry trade foundations shattered — 'cheapness' and 'stability' gone
findings.summary: FoFAHK reports the two core foundations of yen carry trade — 'cheapness' and 'stability' — have been shaken, making it no longer a timely or safe strategy. OpenAccess Blogs warns sustained yen appreciation could force chaotic unwind 'as happened to devastating effect in August 2024.' BOJ signaling Sept rate hike led US to join intervention.

convergence_detection.methodology: For each thread, sum (imminence × impact) for all findings tagged with that thread across different categories. Minimum 2 categories required for convergence. Score >= 50 = DEVELOPING. Score >= 100 = ACTIVE (trigger Telegram alert).

japan_yen.analysis: Yen intervention failing, carry trade foundations shattered, BoJ signaling Sept hike, Australian banking exposure. Multi-category convergence at critical level. Joint US-Japan intervention eroding within 2 weeks. Carry trade unwind risk at highest level since Aug 2024.

us_recession.analysis: Six-category convergence — strongest signal in the system. Jobs report negative (-12,000 to -23,000), participation at 61.4%, Dimon warning on hidden debt, Telegraph calling 'ingredients for crisis,' Fed abandoning forward guidance, HY spreads at 271bps, bond volatility at multi-month highs, BlackRock underweight credit. This is the dominant macro thread.

middle_east_war.analysis: Four-category convergence. Hormuz blocked 5 months, Iran formalizing control, four-crisis convergence (Hormuz/Ukraine/North Korea/China), Russia escalating missile strikes on Kyiv, Iranian domestic unrest with military jammers, Houthis attacking Saudi tankers. 'Guns of August' framing from RealClearDefense.

china_collapse.analysis: Two-category convergence. China property collapsing to 20-year lows, $148B property time bomb (Bloomberg), port congestion at 2.4M TEU, import volumes declining, multi-domain US-China confrontation. Beijing stimulus failing to revive domestic demand.

euro_crisis.analysis: Four-category convergence. ECB unwinding QE while holding rates, EU AI Act hitting banking/credit, MiFID II + Market Abuse Reg updates, Northern Ireland race riots, Ceuta migrant crisis, US intervention sold euros (not dollars) destabilizing EUR. Multiple pressure points.

asian_contagion.analysis: Five-category convergence. Yen carry trade unraveling, Australian banking exposure to yen funding, Asian port congestion at 2.4M TEU, four-crisis geopolitical convergence including China, Kashmir political crisis. Carry trade unwind could spread across Asian economies.

crypto_collapse.analysis: No specific lead indicators for crypto collapse detected in this scan period. Monitor for spillover from yen carry trade unwind and financial stress.

global_pandemic.analysis: No lead indicators for pandemic detected.

Japan yen carry trade unwind risk is the second critical vector with BoJ intervention failing. Middle East remains active with Hormuz blocked 5 months and four-crisis geopolitical convergence. Six threads require Telegram alerts to Roo.
